answer.headline: Go Wrecking Ball; it beats their Sojourn.
reasons: Wrecking Ball into Sojourn: Ball dives Sojourn, and Railgun charge falls off when she is displaced.
Nothing else they have hard-counters Wrecking Ball.
answer.how_to_play: Roll in on isolated backliners, Piledriver groups and grapple out early. Main target: their Sojourn.

answer.headline: Go Zarya into their Sigma: Particle Cannon beam cannot be absorbed by Kinetic Grasp.
reasons: Zarya into Sigma: Particle Cannon beam cannot be absorbed by Kinetic Grasp.
No visible enemy hard-counters Zarya.
answer.how_to_play: Bubble your tank or yourself on their burst and charge up before you fight. Main target: their Sigma.

answer.headline: Go Reinhardt into their D.Va: Barrier Field blocks Fusion Cannons.
reasons: Reinhardt into D.Va: Barrier Field blocks Fusion Cannons.
No visible enemy hard-counters Reinhardt.
answer.how_to_play: Walk them back with Barrier up, swing when they close and save Charge for a pin. Main target: their D.Va.

answer.headline: Go Domina: best overall fit into this comp.
reasons: No visible enemy hard-counters Domina.
Domina has the best overall matchup into Junker Queen.
answer.how_to_play: Hold the choke, poke from behind Barrier Array and Repulse divers off you.

answer.headline: Stay Orisa: you win the Hazard matchup.
reasons: Orisa into Hazard: Energy Javelin stuns him out of leap and Fortify blunts his burst.
Wrecking Ball is only a soft counter here; not worth losing ult charge on a swap.
answer.how_to_play: Hold the frontline, Fortify through their burst and Javelin anyone who commits. Main target: their Hazard.

answer.headline: Stay Reinhardt; no matchup here is worth a swap.

Reinhardt is even into their Zarya, and nobody on their team hard-counters you.

answer.headline: Swap to Torbjörn; it beats their Wrecking Ball and Tracer.
reasons: Torbjörn into Wrecking Ball: Turret targets Ball automatically and helps break Adaptive Shield.
Ashe loses to Wrecking Ball: Ball reaches her high ground and knocks her out of aim.
Torbjörn into Tracer: Turret tracks her and punishes flanks.
answer.how_to_play: On your next death. Set the turret behind cover near the point and Overload when they dive. Main target: their Wrecking Ball.

answer.headline: Stay Tracer: you win the Juno matchup.
reasons: Tracer into Juno: Tracer dives Juno, who has no self-heal.
Ashe is only a soft counter here; not worth losing ult charge on a swap.
answer.how_to_play: Harass their backline from flanks, Recall out and pulse on the engage. Main target: their Juno.

answer.headline: Stay Ramattra; nothing beats their Zenyatta by enough to swap.
reasons: Ramattra into Reinhardt: Nemesis Form punches pierce Barrier Field.
Junker Queen is only a soft counter here; not worth losing ult charge on a swap.
Watch the Zenyatta: Orb of Discord from range.
answer.how_to_play: Poke in Omnic form, then go Nemesis when they commit and punch through shields. Main target: their Reinhardt.

answer.headline: Swap to Anran; it beats their Genji.
reasons: Anran into Genji: Fire burn keeps ticking through Deflect and fans out-trade him at close range.
Widowmaker loses to Genji: Genji dives Widowmaker on an off-angle with no escape.
Anran can fight back when Genji dives.
answer.how_to_play: On your next death. Flank wide, Inferno Rush onto isolated backliners, keep Dancing Blaze to escape. Main target: their Genji.

answer.headline: Stay Kiriko; their comp isn't visible yet.
reasons: No enemy heroes read yet, and an early counter gives them a free re-pick.
Check Tab again once their whole team is on the board.
answer.how_to_play: Stay near your tank, Suzu the key cleanse and teleport out when dove.
